title: Frozen Head State Park
claims: Frozen Head State Park encompasses over 24,000 acres of rugged wilderness in the Cumberland Mountains.
The park is named for the 3,324-foot peak often shrouded in ice during winter.
The park office address is 964 Flat Fork Road, Wartburg, TN 37887.
The park page gives a geolocation of 36.150234142456, -84.503453623082.
As of the access date, the park page lists renovations that close all Big Cove and Flat Fork campsites, the visitor center, Shelters B and C, the Rocky Fork Area, and a number of trails.
During the renovation the only accessible trail listed is the Chimney Top Trail behind the visitor center, described as strenuous with significant elevation gain and up to a 14-mile hike.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取田纳西州立公园官方页面。这是公园管理方页面，不是赛事发布；闭园与步道状态是核查当日页面内容，会随施工变化，不能当作赛事期间的通行保障。
